description_en: Deletes a single Source UModel element
description_zh: 删除 Source UModel 单个元素
kebab_example: aliyun sls delete-source-model-element --project my-project --domain sls --kind log_set --name orders_log --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteSourceModelElement

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. The model belongs to the project, and each project corresponds to one model
parameters.help_zh: Project 名称。模型归属于该 Project，一个 Project 对应一个模型
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The namespace of the element. It uniquely identifies an element together with kind and name. For elements generated by Simple Log Service, this value is typically sls
parameters.help_zh: 元素的命名空间，与 kind、name 一起唯一确定一个元素。由日志服务生成的元素，该值通常为 sls
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The type of the element, such as log_set, metric_set, runbook_set, sls_logstore, and storage_link
parameters.name: kind

parameters.help_en: The name of the element to delete, which is the name field in the element metadata
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的元素名称，即该元素 metadata 中的 name
parameters.name: name

schema.description_en: The response body. It returns the result of the deletion operation
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回本次删除的结果

status.description_en: The status of the operation. A value of success is returned if the deletion is successful. Deleting a non-existent element also returns success. When an element is deleted, storage links that use the element as an endpoint are also deleted. However, other elements that are no longer referenced are not reclaimed
status.description_zh: 调用结果状态。删除成功时固定返回 success；删除一个并不存在的元素同样返回 success。删除元素时，以它为端点的存储关联会被一并删除，但不会回收因此不再被引用的其他元素

v1_parameters.name: project
